verses.1: And the Philistines fought against Israel. An Israelite man went out against the Philistines, and they were defeated and became captives in the mountain of Gilboa.
verses.2: And the Philistines attacked Shaul and his sons. They killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchiah, the sons of Shaul.
verses.3: And the war against Shaul ended. The soldiers found him in the field of battle, and he began to cry out from among the soldiers.
verses.4: And Shaul said to Nunsa, “I will destroy your city with fire. I will also destroy everything in it, so that those evil people won’t be able to come and harm me anymore.” But Nunsa refused to do this, because he was too afraid. So Shaul took the city and destroyed it with fire.
verses.5: And Nahshon saw that Shaul had died, and he also fell down on the ground and died.
verses.6: Shaul and his three sons died, along with everyone in his household.
verses.7: And all the men of Israel saw that Shaul and his sons had been defeated and killed. They left their cities, fled away, and came under the rule of the Philistines.
verses.8: And in the afternoon, the Philistines came to capture the foreigners. They found Shaul and his sons lying dead on Mount Gilboa.
verses.9: They carried him away, and they placed his head and all his possessions in a basket. Then they sent them into the land of Philistines, so that they could share their sorrows with the people there.
verses.10: And they placed all their offerings in their shrines, and they inserted their offerings into the shrine of Dagon.
verses.11: And all the people of Gilad heard all that the Philistines had done to Shaul.
verses.12: And every man stood up, and they lifted up Shaul’s skull and the skulls of his sons. They buried their bodies under the altar in Yavesh. They remained there for seven days.
verses.13: Shaul died on his own hill, where he stood before Jehovah regarding what Jehovah had commanded him. He did not keep His commandments. And Shaul also came to the court of judgment.
verses.14: And he did not ask for help from Jehovah. So Jehovah killed him, and he took the kingdom from David, son of Jesse.
